lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is the Telluride Medical Center's special board meeting on Monday, where a proposal to engage Jensen Partners for due diligence with CommonSpirit Health — one of the country's largest hospital systems — is on the table, a signal that a major affiliation decision may be taking shape. Ouray City Council is also holding a public hearing on its 2027 budget and voting on utility rate ordinances on second reading. Closer to home, the Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered lawn and garden equipment in town limits, with leaf blowers first on the chopping block by 2028.
